description: Propose a new time for a session on behalf of the client — opens the bilateral coordination loop by creating a pending SessionRequest (it does NOT move the session; the org resolves it with booking_resolve_request). Provide requestedScheduledAt as an ISO datetime (must be future, within ~3 months). Gated by the org's session-request flow flag and rate-limited per (client, session). The event records the session's client as the proposer. Use booking_list_requests to track pending requests.
name: portal_propose_reschedule
